purpose: Plan empirical comparisons of home-processable polymer candidates; compute ideal pre-treatment feed budgets without predicting waterproofing or biodegradation.

pcl_repeat.scope: Ideal polycaprolactone repeat unit; excludes chain ends, commercial-grade additives and moisture. Purchased PCL is reshaped, not synthesized at home.

starch_repeat.scope: Ideal anhydroglucose repeat unit. Nominal dry-feed bookkeeping only; as-received starch moisture and impurities must be measured.

sodium_alginate_repeat.scope: Ideal sodium-alginate repeat unit with one initial carboxylate site; excludes chain ends, additives and moisture. Final ion exchange and retained composition are unknown.

glycerol.scope: Ideal glycerol feed; commercial concentration and actual retention must be recorded.

calcium_lactate_pentahydrate.scope: Explicit pentahydrate bath feed, represented without hydrate-dot notation. Availability is not uptake or crosslink density.

calcium_lactate_anhydrous_diagnostic.scope: Same-mass hydration-state diagnostic only; not the salt used in the planned baths.

water.scope: Casting and bath feed solvent; excluded from ideal modeled nonwater elemental feed.

sources.scope: Manufacturer forming directions for purchased PCL; plain-PCL reshaping evidence does not establish starch-blend processing or wet performance.
Manufacturer limitations including hot softening and uncertified food contact; not a waterproofing or biodegradation certification.
Manufacturer-linked PCL safety data and water insolubility; PDF internally reviewed in 2015. Insolubility does not prove leak-free objects.
Laboratory alginate/wax film water-vapor permeability evidence; not a validation of the proposed home-applied topcoat or liquid-water resistance.
Alginate/calcium-lactate film literature review; exact planned bath duration and resulting calcium uptake are unvalidated.
Condition-dependent PCL soil mass-loss evidence; not mineralization evidence or home-compost certification for these formulations.
